sources.title: GitHub - Babitdor/Speech_Emotion_Recognition_Wav2Vec
sources.snippet: This project implements Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) using Wav2Vec2 and the Hugging Face Transformers library. It supports training, evaluation, and inference on custom or public emotion-labeled speech datasets.

sources.title: Wav2vec 2.0: Learning the structure of speech from raw audio
sources.snippet: Facebook AI is releasing code and models for wav2vec 2.0, a self-supervised algorithm that enables automatic speech recognition models with just 10 minutes of transcribed speech data.
